what: Over the list, a small thumbnail card (83×111, 10px rounded, black and white) sticks to the lower right of the cursor — the value pushed back by the movement shrinks by 0.85× every frame (grouped at 60fps), so it follows with a lag, and it switches to the photo of the hovered row. It appears in .4s on entering and disappears on leaving

options.[data-fx-part=item]: Rows to hover (children) — paired with photos in order
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photos (children) layered inside the card — line i ↔ photo i
options.decay: Fraction of the lagged value kept each frame, default 0.85 (smaller sticks sooner, 0 sticks right to the cursor)
options.--fx-filter: Card filter (via style), default saturate(0) — none to keep the original color

note: On touch devices (no hover) the card is hidden and nothing is attached. The card is position: fixed, so do not put it inside an ancestor that has a transform

from.where: index.html, news.html .sp-news-list (News row ↔ black-and-white thumbnail card, original .js-cursor__area / .js-cursor__pointer)

index.js archive — original archive list: a 340px panel (its center is the cursor) follows the mouse position inside the list every frame by .2 of the remaining distance (decay .8 type), scale 0→1 .2s on entering the list, and each row swaps two photos every 2s (this swap has no part option — it lives only in site code).
